onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

si_perf.Description: Performance measured as Spatial Information contained in lick histogram. Computed per sessionfrom trial-averaged lick histogram. Used in paper.

blr_perf.Description: Performance measured as Binned Lick Ratio (ratio of individual licks within vs. outside of reward zones). Computed per trial. Not used in paper.

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
